subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron run status and expose yielded-parent lifecycle state through plugin-facing SDK/hook contracts in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible bug fix, but it expands persisted/protocol/plugin-visible contracts and changes channel-visible lifecycle timing, which automation cannot approve as product/API direction.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Require the missing Discord, best-effort, and upgrade proof, resolve conflicts, then let maintainers accept the new public status and SDK/hook surface.

options.title: Split Public Surface
options.body: Keep the internal yielded-parent bug fix but split or defer the `deferred` status and SDK/hook additions until the contract is separately approved.

options.title: Reject The Public Contract
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers do not want a public `deferred` state or plugin-facing lifecycle classifier yet.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Require the missing Discord, best-effort, and upgrade proof, resolve conflicts, then let maintainers accept the new public status and SDK/hook surface.
